description: This file defines multiple Marshmallow schemas for product data validation and serialization, including schemas for creating, updating, and listing products.

classes.name: ProductBaseSchema
classes.description: Base schema for shared product fields, including validation for price and quantity.

classes.name: ProductCreateSchema
classes.description: Schema for creating a product, extending ProductBaseSchema.

classes.name: ProductUpdateSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating a product with optional fields and validation.

classes.name: ProductResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for product response data, including product ID, name, price, and quantity.

classes.name: ProductsListResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for list response containing multiple products and total count.

methods.name: validate_price
methods.description: Validates that the price is non-negative.

methods.name: validate_quantity
methods.description: Validates that the quantity is non-negative.
